roadmap.title: Opening story and first activities
roadmap.description: Play the Prologue and Memory Sequences 1-3. Visit Versailles, buy your first Social Club once Sequence 2 opens Paris, and try your first Murder Mystery.

roadmap.title: Main story with Paris activities
roadmap.description: Finish Sequences 4-12 and the Helix Rifts that open with them. Along the way, renovate the Café Théâtre and all Social Clubs, learn the Locksmith and combat skills, and clear the counter achievements as they come up.

roadmap.title: Clean-up and co-op
roadmap.description: After the story, finish the collectibles, replay missions for every challenge, unlock all skills, and complete the co-op missions and heists with a partner.

roadmap.title: Dead Kings
roadmap.description: Travel to Franciade by carriage from the Café Théâtre. Finish Sequence 13, the Suger riddles, outposts and Dead Kings co-op and heist, then complete 100% synchronization.

steps.text: Play the opening story until the Prologue ends.
Play the main story until Memory Sequence 1 is complete.
Play the main story until Memory Sequence 2 is complete.
Play the main story until Memory Sequence 3 is complete.
Play the main story until Memory Sequence 4 is complete.
Play the main story until Memory Sequence 5 is complete.
Play the main story until Memory Sequence 6 is complete.
Play the main story until Memory Sequence 7 is complete.
Play the main story until Memory Sequence 8 is complete.
Play the main story until Memory Sequence 9 is complete.
Play the main story until Memory Sequence 10 is complete.
Play the main story until Memory Sequence 11 is complete.
Play the main story until Memory Sequence 12 is complete.

achievements.summary: Complete all seven Helix Rift missions.

guide.context: Rifts open in three groups after the Server Bridge missions at the end of Sequences 3, 7 and 11. A rift can only be started from its marker in the world, not from the Progress Tracker.

steps.text: Start a Helix Rift from its marker on the map.
Collect data and kill enemies until the first score is reached. A trapped Assassin then appears on the map.
Free the Assassin, then run to the exit portal before time runs out.
The seven rifts are Belle Époque Data Harvest and Tornado; Occupied Paris Covert, Data Harvest and Tower; Medieval France Battlefield and Quarry.

achievements.summary: Earn 3 data bonuses in Helix Rift missions.

guide.context: The second score appears only after you free the trapped Assassin. Score targets differ in each rift.

steps.text: Reach the first score and free the trapped Assassin.
Keep collecting data until you reach the second, higher score before time runs out.
Earn the bonus in three different rifts.
Green data is worth 50 points. Stand on a green pickup for a few seconds to collect it.

achievements.description: Free a total of 10 trapped Assassins.
achievements.summary: Free 10 trapped Assassins in Helix Rift missions.

guide.context: There are only seven rifts, so you must replay at least three of them.

steps.text: In a rift, collect data until the first score is reached, then free the trapped Assassin.
Replay rifts until you have freed 10 Assassins in total.

guide.context: Only hidden-blade kills made while undetected count. Air assassinations count too.

steps.text: Kill enemies with the hidden blade without being detected until you reach 100.

achievements.description: Complete all Single Player mission challenges.
achievements.summary: Complete every challenge in the single-player story missions of Memory Sequences 1 to 12.

guide.context: Open the pause menu in a mission to see its challenges. Every challenge of a mission has to be finished in one run. You can replay story missions from the Progress Tracker.

steps.text: Check the challenges at the start of each story mission in Sequences 1 to 12.
If you fail a challenge, restart the checkpoint or replay the mission from the Progress Tracker.
Buy the skills some missions need before you play them.
steps.note: Sequence 5 The Silversmith: Apprentice Locksmith. Sequence 5 La Halle aux Blés: Ranged Weapon. Sequence 6 Templar Ambush: Double Assassination. Sequence 7 A Cautious Alliance: Bombs: Stun Grenades. Sequence 7 Confrontation: Staggering Strike. Sequence 11 Bottom of the Barrel: Bombs: Poison Gas. Sequence 12 The Fall of Robespierre: Master Locksmith. Sequence 12 The Temple: Double Air Assassination.

steps.text: In Sequence 9 Hoarders, free @npc{Thomas Lévesque}. He is on the right side of the palace; climb the roof and enter through an upper window.
"From cover" kills are done while pressed against a wall. "From hiding spot" kills are done from inside haystacks, wardrobes or benches.
After Memory Sequence 2, go to a red house icon on the map and buy that Social Club.

achievements.description: Renovate all the Social Clubs and complete all the Social Club missions.
achievements.summary: Renovate all seven Social Clubs and complete all of their missions.

guide.context: Each club has its own missions, which start once you buy it.

steps.text: Buy every Social Club (red house icons on the map).
steps.note: The clubs are Café de la Bièvre, Café de l'Île de la Cité, Café des Invalides, Café du Louvre, Café du Marais, Café du Quartier Latin and Café du Ventre de Paris.

steps.text: Complete every mission of each club.
Buy clubs early. They raise the passive income of the @loc{Café Théâtre}.
Get above an enemy on a tree, rope or rooftop and press the assassinate input to drop on them. Do this 10 times.

achievements.description: Unlock the Medieval Armor in the Café Théâtre.
achievements.summary: Unlock the Medieval Armor in the Café Théâtre.

guide.context: Each Nostradamus Enigma is a riddle that points to a place on the map. After the last one, a puzzle under the @loc{Café Théâtre} gives the armor.

steps.text: Open the scroll icons on the map and solve all 18 Nostradamus Enigmas by going to the place each riddle describes.
Go to the basement under the @loc{Café Théâtre} and finish the mechanism puzzle.
steps.note: Its stages open after 4, 10 and 18 enigmas. The last stage has three rooms with three levers.

steps.text: Take the armor at the end.

guide.context: Co-op missions can be played alone by choosing "Play in private".

steps.text: Start any co-op mission from its marker on the map and finish it.

achievements.summary: Complete all training missions in the Café Théâtre.

guide.context: Most training missions need the matching skill to be bought first.

steps.text: Buy skills in Customization > Skills.
Go upstairs in the @loc{Café Théâtre} and talk to the trainer (crossed swords icon).
Finish all 21 training missions. A white tick marks each finished one.

guide.context: Locked chests show as red chest icons on the map. Locksmith level 2 opens after Sequence 5 and level 3 after Sequence 9.

steps.text: Buy the @mechanic{Apprentice Locksmith} skill and get lockpicks, which you can loot from enemies or buy.
Walk to a red chest icon and finish the lockpicking minigame.
Repeat until you have opened 20 locked chests.

achievements.description: Open every chest in the game.
achievements.summary: Open every chest in Paris and Versailles.

guide.context: Level 2 and 3 locks need the Locksmith skills that open after Sequences 5 and 9.

steps.text: Finish Memory Sequence 9 and buy all three Locksmith skills.
Buy the Cockades & Chests map: main menu > eStore > Time Saver Pack.
steps.note: Helix credits from the story pay for it. Sync a viewpoint in a region to show its chests.

steps.text: Open the white chests and pick the red ones district by district until none are left.
The underground chest in the Tuileries stays sealed until you finish Sequence 8 Memory 1.
One chest is behind a door that opens only after four Paris Stories: Grand and dark unknowns, and the Flamel's secret stories The Monks, Denis Molinier and The Elixir of Life.
Also open the Nomad (blue) and Initiate (gold) chests. They are unlocked and unguarded.

achievements.description: Complete all Co-op and Heist missions at least once.
achievements.summary: Complete all 11 co-op missions and all 7 heists in Paris at least once.

guide.context: You can play them alone with "Play in private", but it is harder.

steps.text: Complete all 11 co-op missions. Each one is marked on the map and turns yellow once finished.
Complete all 7 heists in the same way.
Dying in a heist resets it completely.
Keep playing. Missions, chests and Social Club or @loc{Café Théâtre} income add up, and you do not need to hold 50,000 at once.
Buying clubs and renovations early raises your passive income.

achievements.summary: Perform a ground execution on a downed enemy.

guide.context: You need three skills first: Staggering Strike, One-handed Weapon Master and Ground Execution.

steps.text: Buy the three skills.
Knock a regular soldier down with a Staggering Strike, then press the attack input on the downed enemy.
Brutes are immune to Staggering Strike.
Climb to the top of each viewpoint and press the sync input. Syncing also reveals nearby missions and collectibles.

guide.context: Crowd events appear at random while you roam. The mini-map shows a red or yellow circle.

steps.text: Run to the circle and finish the task. Do this for 10 events.
Tackle thieves from behind when prompted. Draw a weapon next to bullies. Kill criminals. Throw a money pouch at beggars, which needs the Money Pouch skill.

guide.context: Murder Mysteries open early in Sequence 2.

steps.text: Go to a magnifying glass icon on the map.
Inspect clues until you can accuse someone, then name a suspect. A wrong accusation still completes the case.

guide.context: Versailles opens after the second mission of Sequence 1. Later you can reach it from the V icon next to the @loc{Café Théâtre}.

steps.text: Travel to Versailles.
Sync the viewpoints, open all chests and collect all cockades there until Versailles shows 100%.

guide.context: Enigmas open after Sequence 2.

steps.text: Open a scroll icon on the map and go to the place its riddle describes.

guide.context: The map shows how many cockades you have found in each region.

steps.text: Finish the story first, so most of the map is revealed.
Buy the Cockades & Chests map: main menu > eStore > Time Saver Pack.
Collect the cockades district by district, including those in Versailles.
The underground cockade in the Tuileries opens only after Sequence 8 Memory 1.

achievements.description: Drop 20 Money Pouches in the streets.
achievements.summary: Drop a money pouch on the street 20 times.

steps.text: After Memory Sequence 2, buy the @mechanic{Bombs: Money Pouch} skill.
Drop a pouch on the street 20 times.
In a mission, restart the checkpoint to get your pouches back.

achievements.description: Watch a play in the Café Théâtre.
achievements.summary: Watch a play in the Café Théâtre.

guide.context: Plays begin after the @loc{Café Théâtre} renovations are bought.

steps.text: Buy the renovations at the @loc{Café Théâtre} so performances start.
In the daytime stand near the stage and watch. If nothing happens, stay for the next play.

achievements.description: Get all the rewards in a Co-op mission.
achievements.summary: Unlock every gear reward of one co-op mission.

guide.context: A co-op mission gives a different gear reward on each of its first three completions. Sync points do not count.

steps.text: Choose one co-op mission.
Complete it three times, using "Play in private" if you are alone.

achievements.description: Perform all Social Club missions in a district.
achievements.summary: Complete all Social Club missions of one district.

steps.text: Buy a Social Club and finish all of its missions.

achievements.description: Enjoy the view of Paris from Arno's balcony.
achievements.summary: Watch the view of Paris from Arno's balcony.

guide.context: The room may stay closed until more @loc{Café Théâtre} renovations are bought.

steps.text: Go upstairs in the @loc{Café Théâtre}, enter Arno's room and walk out onto the balcony.
Press nothing. Arno walks to the rail and leans on it. Wait about two minutes.

achievements.description: Kill 20 enemies with a Long Weapon.

steps.text: Buy a long weapon and equip it in Customization > Gear Loadout > Weapons > Long.
Kill 20 enemies with it.

achievements.description: Kill 20 enemies with a heavy weapon.

steps.text: Buy a heavy weapon and equip it in Customization > Gear Loadout > Weapons > Heavy.
Kill 20 enemies with it.

achievements.description: Complete all the renovations of the Café Théâtre.
achievements.summary: Buy all five renovations of the Café Théâtre.

guide.context: Renovations are bought at the Intendant's Study in the @loc{Café Théâtre}.

steps.text: Finish all five @loc{Café Théâtre} missions first.
Buy the five renovations: Ground Floor, Hall, Exteriors, Upper Floors and Finishing Touches.
If the achievement does not appear, interact with the "Inspect the Café Théâtre" book, stand still for 5 to 10 minutes, then check your achievements.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a lift counterweight.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy using a lift's counterweight.

guide.context: The enemy must stand directly under the counterweight when the lift moves.

steps.text: Get guards chasing you and lead them to a lift.
Stand so the guards are under the counterweight, then ride the lift up.
A smoke bomb keeps guards in place.

achievements.summary: Revive a partner in a co-op mission.

guide.context: You need a second player.

steps.text: When your partner is downed, run to their skull marker and hold the interact input (E on keyboard).

achievements.description: Perform 10 non-lethal takedowns in a Co-op mission.
achievements.summary: Perform 10 non-lethal takedowns in one co-op mission.

guide.context: You must stay undetected, and all 10 takedowns must happen in the same mission. You can play alone with "Play in private".

steps.text: Start a co-op mission.
Sneak behind an unaware enemy and hold the takedown input (E) until they pass out. Do this 10 times.
A smoke bomb helps if you are spotted.

achievements.summary: Perform 10 synchronized kills with a co-op partner.

guide.context: You need a partner. Both of you must kill within 3 to 4 seconds of each other. A "Double Assassination" or "Triple Assassination" banner confirms each one.

steps.text: In a co-op mission, pick targets such as pairs of guards.
Kill them together with your partner. Repeat until you have 10. Kills from different missions add up.
If the count does not rise, try again with another partner or within one mission.
Run up to an alarm bell and press the interact input. Do this for 5 bells.
In a mission, restarting the checkpoint lets you sabotage the same bell again.

guide.context: You need the @mechanic{Apprentice Locksmith} skill and lockpicks.

steps.text: Buy the skill, and loot or buy lockpicks.
Find a locked door in a mission or in Paris and finish the lockpicking minigame. Do this for 5 doors.

guide.context: All skills together cost 129 sync points. Story and co-op missions alone do not give enough, so the sync points hidden in the co-op missions are needed.

steps.text: Finish Memory Sequences 1 to 12. Skills open in batches after Sequences 2, 5 and 9.
Complete the co-op missions (alone with "Play in private" works).
Collect every sync point pickup in the co-op missions. You can take them without finishing the mission, but some are behind doors that need Locksmith level 2 or 3.
Buy every skill in Customization > Skills.

guide.context: Everything in Franciade counts, including the catacombs.

steps.text: Complete the six missions of Sequence 13 with all their challenges.
Complete the 4 Stories of Franciade and both Murder Mysteries. Mysteries need one main-game Murder Mystery done first.
Solve the 7 Suger's Legacy riddles, free the 3 outposts, and play the DLC's one heist and one co-op mission.
Sync the 3 viewpoints and collect every chest, the 26 Napoleon's bicorns and the 14 artifacts.
After the story ends, every catacomb route is open. Use Eagle Vision to spot collectibles.

achievements.summary: Complete Memory Sequence 13 in Dead Kings.

guide.context: Franciade opens after Sequence 5 of the main game. Travel there by the carriage next to the @loc{Café Théâtre}. You cannot return to Paris until the first two Dead Kings missions are done.

steps.text: Play the six Dead Kings missions in order.

achievements.description: Complete Suger's Legacy and recover the Eagle of Suger.
achievements.summary: Solve all seven Suger's Legacy riddles and recover the Eagle of Suger.

guide.context: The first two riddles are part of the story after Memory 3 and unlock the other five.

steps.text: Solve the two story riddles, V - Crux and III - Diabolus.
Solve the other five from their markers on the map. Each riddle hides four symbols in Franciade, like the Nostradamus Enigmas.
After the seventh, follow the final marker and take the Eagle of Suger.

achievements.summary: Free all three outposts in Franciade.

steps.text: Open the outpost missions marked on the Franciade map.
At each outpost, defeat its three targets to free it.

achievements.description: Complete the Heist and the Co-op mission in Dead Kings at least once.
achievements.summary: Complete the Dead Kings heist and co-op mission at least once.

guide.context: Both missions open early in the Dead Kings story. You can play both alone with "Play in private".

steps.text: Complete the Dead Kings heist.
Complete the Dead Kings co-op mission, in which you defend a group of guards.

achievements.description: Kill 5 enemies at the same time with a Guillotine Gun.
achievements.summary: Kill 5 enemies with one blast from a Guillotine Gun.

guide.context: The gun is handed to you in Memory 2.

steps.text: After you get the gun, aim at the group of enemies right ahead.
Fire the mortar shot so at least 5 are caught in the blast. If you miss, reload the checkpoint.

guide.context: Raider leaders have a red background with a white star. Eagle Vision highlights them. Killing the leader breaks up the group.

steps.text: Kill the leader of each Raider group you meet in the catacombs.
Exploring the catacombs for collectibles usually gets you there. The leaders near the gun in Memory 2 can be repeated by reloading the checkpoint.
